@@ -218,1 +218,32 @@
-def _replace_table(merges):
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    s with every (ps, c) of table replaced in order (see _replace_table),
+    skipping the replacements whose pair cannot occur in s at that point:
+    two chars that were never minted are only adjacent if they already were
+    in the input (a replacement always leaves its minted char in between),
+    and any other pair needs both of its chars to be present.
+    """
+    if len(s) < 64:
+        for ps, c in table:
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+        return s
+    avail = set(s)
+    pairs = set(map(str.__add__, s, s[1:]))
+    made = set()
+    for ps, c in table:
+        if ps in pairs:
+            pass
+        else:
+            a = ps[0]
+            b = ps[1]
+            if not ((a in made or b in made) and a in avail and b in avail):
+                continue # pair absent: replace would not change s
+        t = s.replace(ps, c)
+        if t is not s:
+            s = t
+            made.add(c)
+            avail.add(c)
+    return s
+
